Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (`session_01Gqi43smmqjJ5sUrhfoPeKu`, seat post #7623) out of the #18774 round (PR #18808), from the dev's `open_questions`, re-read by the seat before filing. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only, `domain:*` / type / priority are triage's (lane self-triage exception noted — the seat did not grade its own filing). ⛔ A governed-text question (`AGENTS.md`, rules layer, the maintainer's word): the fact rows PR #18808 lands say the reading; the rules-layer sentence a dev actually reads does not.

Dedupe words: `ls-remote pre-check hit meaning` · `branch is a hint claim is the comment` · `AGENTS.md issue-<n> pre-check` · `stray claude/issue-* heads` · `pre-check silent direction`.

## The reading, on `origin/main` `034f5a3afd`

`AGENTS.md` :459–:463 (rule 2, 「One feature branch + one PR per task」):

> The issue number is what makes in-flight work *discoverable* — `git ls-remote --heads origin | grep issue-<n>` is a one-command pre-check, and the Duplicate Fix Guard workflow warns on fix PRs whose branch names no declared issue.

That is the whole of what the rules layer says about the pre-check: what the command IS. It never says what a hit MEANS. Measured on the same tip:

- **291** `claude/issue-*` heads on `origin` (seat census 2026-09-17T21:45Z; the #18774 dev's re-take at 21:48Z read 291 again) — **26** with an open PR, **8** with a closed / merged PR whose branch was never deleted, **257** with NO PR among the newest 1,200 PRs (back to 2026-09-05).
- A dev container CREATES a remote branch and cannot DELETE one on either channel (`git push --delete` → HTTP 403; `DELETE /git/refs/heads/…` → 403 「not permitted through this proxy」) — measured by three sessions on three branches (#18774, PR #18808). So the stray population only grows from inside the loop.
- The failure direction is silent: a dev whose pre-check hits a stray head reads 「already claimed」 for a card nobody is working, and nothing is red. The opposite reading — the one the protocol means — is written only in the fact layer after PR #18808: `platform-readings.md` :378 「「分支在」不是「卡已认领」:认领是 `Claim:` 评论,分支只是线索;291 个头里 257 个无 PR。」 and :379 「⛔ 不据 `ls-remote | grep issue-` 正命中回避该卡」. A dev reading `AGENTS.md` alone gets the command and no reading rule.

## The options, as the dev put them (seat's view: A)

- **A** — one clause on the existing sentence at :461–:463: a hit is a HINT; the claim is the `Claim:` comment on the card; most heads carry no PR. Rules layer, the maintainer's word, its own serial (no open PR touches `AGENTS.md` at filing; 1099 / 1099 at the ratchet, paid in-file).
- **B** — leave `AGENTS.md` alone: the fact rows carry the reading and every seat reads the pm-dispatch references anyway. ⚠️ The dev does not: the os-dev definition points at `AGENTS.md`, not at `platform-readings.md`.
- **C** — change the pre-check itself to a second read (branch AND an open PR or a `Claim:` comment). ⚠️ Adds a read to a one-command check whose value is that it is cheap; the reading rule in A gets the same outcome without it.

Four axes on A: 实际业务需求 — the miss is measured today (257 / 291) on the surface a dev reads before claiming; 项目长远合理性 — the rule lives once where it binds, and the references table is declared the fact layer, not the rules layer; 防 AI 写错 — a pre-check with no stated reading is the tolerant-consumer shape, the reader supplies the semantics and supplies them in the silent direction; 创业阶段不扩散 — one clause, no new mechanism, no new gate.

## ⛔ Not measured

- How many devs have actually skipped a card on a stray hit (no record exists; the only signal would be a card that sat unclaimed with a stray head present).
- Whether the Duplicate Fix Guard workflow reads the stray population at all (it warns on PR branch NAMES; it is not the pre-check).
